dispositions.basis: The employee scenario still imports and calls rankCars through server/engine.js; the direct shared-core migration and employee/retail parity acceptance are not delivered.
The remaining default-scenario proposal is delivered by accepted FUCQ-362 Start again, which resets to Main successful journey. Accepted FUCQ-272 supplies the earlier focus/principal repair.
The embedded compact-strip proposal is superseded by Gary's approved standalone console and accepted FUCQ-360/361; the old embedded workspace was removed.
The remaining top decision-summary proposal is delivered by accepted FUCQ-383/386: summary, deadline and decisions precede the gallery on narrow screens, with declarations in confirmation drawers.
Manual review still exposes Change car, Cancel review, Save details and Continue separately. The action-disclosure and single carried reservation-deadline proposal is not fully delivered.
Setup still renders separate Save choices and Continue actions. The related copy fixes do not complete this proposal to merge them.
The larger demand cohort and proposed dashboard section/rail order remain separate scope; FUCQ-293's privacy-band display fix did not implement this proposal.
FUCQ-295 supplies the headline/scale/label repairs. The current process comparison still renders all measures; the proposal to lead with three and fold the remainder is not delivered.

FUCQ-297 fixed queue actions, headings and help visibility. The proposed general employee accept/reply remedy flow has no complete delivery record; the existing single-preference confirmation is narrower.

Partial improvements have landed: FUCQ-302 records tick time falling from 640.3 to 13.5 ms, and later work compacts allocation/clock readback. The complete requested Tick/Reset event-loop profiling and resolution is not evidenced; retain the remaining scope rather than declare the whole Story accepted.

Accepted FUCQ-360/361 removed the embedded presenter workspace and presenter imports from employee/Greg pages. Its strip remount/readback contract is obsolete; unrelated repeated API reads are not declared fixed.
GCSP entry pages still eagerly load multiple journey modules/styles. FUCQ-367's versioned caching/preloads explicitly excluded trimming/restructuring the module graph.
The after-demo hatchback retraining/activation hold remains. No delivered artifact and activation-gate evidence establishes the requested hatchback coverage.
The console has separate reset, principal-switch and fault Set commands. Its redesign does not supply the single confirmed setup transaction and refined persistence lifetime required here.

The standalone console/shared run exists, but audience refresh signals remain same-origin browser storage events. The independent-client refresh/reconnect walkthrough and coverage required by this Story are not complete.
Basic Release and Advanced Tick still advance time deliberately. Accepted manual controls do not implement the autonomous rate, lifecycle, pause/reset and ownership/reconnect contract.
The accepted offer work explicitly preserves meaningful exact-configuration/high-value option comparisons as this separate unfinished scope; readable definitions alone do not complete it.

Configured identity and existing account/history projections are partial foundations. The minimal supported history fields still require refinement, with no complete same-record consistency delivery across profile, Your cars and comparison.

Current preview still uses the shared Best match/Recommended badge. Later points-ranking and wider page changes do not record the specifically requested prominence assessment and complete acceptance evidence.
The existing decline/change replay is Touring to Saloon. The later presenter spec explicitly retains no SUV for that scenario, so the requested repeatable SUV walkthrough remains outstanding.
The larger demand cohort remains explicitly deferred. Releasing more cars does not establish enough employee briefs/offers/declines to clear the privacy bands.
The HTML link now has a short View offer label and the greeting is personalised, but the HTML body still opens with GCSP employee vehicle scheme. The complete greeting-first requirement is unmet.
Manual setup still renders Save choices and Continue as separate actions; a single Save and continue with the specified validation behavior is not delivered.

The manual-route revamp remains deferred. Review still edits contact details and summary repeats them; the requested rows, single contact capture, blocked-card variant and one exit per step are not all delivered.
The standalone case queue still mounts directly in main without portalShell/Greg navigation. Existing row Open actions do not satisfy the full shell, column, form-order and date proposal.
Shared vehicle typography and the offer decision card are partial reuse. There is no complete adopted single car-summary component across all six named screens, which the revamp explicitly deferred.
Explicitly deferred until collaborator prioritisation. The November archive cleanup precedes this remaining-bloat Story and does not complete it.

transitions.basis: Explicit collaborator acceptance on 12 November; approved Your cars, presentation polish and Buddy/details merges are documented in docs/gcsp/your-cars-fucq405.md.

The remaining proposal to default reset to Main successful journey is implemented by FUCQ-362 Start again; FUCQ-272 covers focus/principal recovery. FUCQ-362 was accepted with the reviewed Stories on 12 November. See _dev/done/2026-11/DEV-2026-11-10-GC-039.md and blocks/gcsp/presenter-controls/basic-model.js.

Superseded by Gary's approved standalone Basic/Advanced console and removal of embedded controls/workspace in accepted FUCQ-360/361. A compact employee-page presenter strip is no longer the agreed architecture. See docs/gcsp/presenter-revamp-spec.md and _dev/done/2026-11/DEV-2026-11-10-GC-038.md.

The remaining proposal for a decision summary at the top is implemented by accepted FUCQ-383/386: the offer has a prominent deadline, summary and decisions before the gallery on narrow screens, with declarations in confirmation drawers. See docs/gcsp/vehicle-offer-stories-2026-11-11.md, docs/gcsp/dev-poller-fucq380-2026-11-11.md and blocks/gcsp/offer/offer-view.js.

Superseded by accepted FUCQ-360/361: the embedded presenter workspace/strip was removed and employee/Greg pages no longer import presenter-controls. Its remount/readback-preservation request no longer applies. This does not claim unrelated repeated API reads are fixed. See _dev/done/2026-11/DEV-2026-11-10-GC-038.md.
